Before I go home, I need to get the ship repaired.
Hey, dude. What do you need?
Umm… an estimate on how much it’ll cost to repair my ship.
Again? Second time this week.You must be getting into a lot of fights, huh?
Well, you can pay now, or you can pay after the job.
Thanks, man. Come back in a day or so.It’ll be done by tomorrow.
The cheapest way home is by train. The station’s just north from here.

AR2—model3089An economic model not meant for major combat. Medium sized storage bays & lowest possible fuel consumption.
M450 CannonAdd-on available to most small to medium sized ships.Launches explosive shots for medium damage.
2XII-model2.5A model made for mainly merchants. Large storage bays. Oh, and good hull strength too. Other than that pretty wimpy.

Secret message!!Yah baby!This is the first time I everDrew the Leahin without using the original radio menu picture as the head!100% freehand, baby!I’d say it looks pretty good, huh?
Oh… Caina…it’s you… Why are you here?
Any reason I can’t be here? I was just out shopping and I just decided to stop by…
Secret message!!lol this train animation is sadly pathetic…
It’s here! Come on, Leahin, lets go!
You’ve been acting all depressed…What happened?
Hmm… the mission?Oh, allright I guess.
So, that means that they’ll leave…
That’s great! I guess you’re safe now, huh?
Oh, umm.. I’m leaving on a trip tomorrow.
Really? And when will you be back?
Ohh.. Not for a while, I think.Maybe a month or so. Sorry.
It doesn’t really matter, I’m probably not gonna be around here for long…
Then I guess I’ll be seeing you later. Call if you need me.
Building 342…Before I go back, I better get some rest…
Out of order… I’ll have to use the emergency stairs.
I guess I can assume you know why I’m here. Sit down, and maybe we can have a chat.

All your base are belong to us!  HAhAHa!     Leahin said “IT YOU!” I did it on purpose!         You actually thought I was capable of making grammar errors???What? You don’t get the joke?                                   Well, if you were                   you’d get it…-Shiny
OH SCHNAPPSYOU FREEZE THE GAME
OH SCHNAPPSYOU FREEZE THE GAME
OH SCHNAPPSYOU FREEZE THE GAME
It means that you failed that mission.You know what I’m talking about.
HAhAHa… the corporation never really expected any better from you.
We just sent you out to do the work nobody else wanted to do. We just wanted him dead.
It was all set up.It was just a test of your skill.
We were all just thinking that if you could never pay, you could work for us from now on.
Ha ha… work for you… that’s a dead-end job…
Same opinion on our side. We just think you aren’t cut out for work in our business.
And then you’ll leave me alone?That’s a thought.
Now that wouldn’t be the way we operate around here, wouldn’t it?
Hands up.. You’re coming with me.
Hands up.. You’re coming with me.
Heh heh… A gun. You sure came prepared.
Heh heh… A gun. You sure came prepared.
You sure got the look goin’ for ya…A suit… round glasses.. Even a tie! Evil corporate agent.. Nice style.
Pathetic last words. Don’t get me angry.
Heh.. Lame story there. “It was just all a test of your skill.” Sounds like a wanna-be Neon Genesis Evangelion style plot twist there…
Okay,.. You know what? I’ve had enough of . Shut Up for Good!!
Okay,.. You know what? I’ve had enough of . Shut Up for Good!!
Full of vexation come I, with complaint against my child, my daughter Hermia.
Heh.. That worked out nice.Now I should…
(that punch animation was pretty awesome, eh?)
Ask questions. Stufu. Or David style, SNUFU!!
Now tell me… What was that you were talking about…. A test? Why are you here?
Now tell me… Why are you here? What do you want?
Wait.. What? You’re not in the position to be making the decisions here…
Uhh… what are you trying to do…?
Wait.. You’re not gonna jump…are you….
Exactly. Don’t think it’s over… I’ll be back. Later.
LOL that turned out funnier than expected.
I doubt anyone could of survived that…
Is he dead… Is it all over?
…He said he would be coming back…and if not him, someone else…
I should leave… They could come back any time… I need a place to stay, at least overnight.. but where…?
I need somewhere to stay… Not here, though I’m sure they’ll be coming back…Where though… Let me think…
That’s it! I know, I can stay at Caina’s place!The trains are closed now… Maybe I could go there on a Taxi…
I need somewhere to stay… Not here, though I’m sure they’ll be coming back…Where though… Let me think…
Auto-Taxi system…? Never used one of these before…
Err… Show a map of the surrounding area… Can you do that?
*ZZT*…*ZZZT*… This is  system Quisti Vela VI galactic Taxi service… model 3X Hovercraft… How may I be of service...?
I know Caina lives near City 87…
Of course. Now, can you pay the 50 credits it’ll cost?
50 credits…? I’ve got exactly that much.
Yay the big 202. This game has now officially grown larger than goblinsRPG3. 8/19/2005
Err… I just slide it down this slot… right?
It is. Please have a seat, sir. The car will start moving shortly.
…… So, how are you doing? Everything allright in your life?
Err… I’m allright I guess…Why’d you ask?
I dunno… Just that I’m bored…How far are we, anyway?
So, how do you like your job?
Why are you asking so many personal questions… What are you trying to suggest?
N-Nothing… I was just wondering… It’s just that there’s nothing to do…
I guess… If you must know… I’m just doing this part time… To earn money for college.
College? What are you gonna do there?
Heh… I wanted to be a Journalist. Ever since I was young…
Err… Well good luck to you, I guess.
…Thanks. We’ve arrived at Citydome 87. It was nice meeting you.
Oh wow that worked out nice.
Oh.. Man…I forgot… I don’t even know where Caina lives…
Oh.. Man…I forgot… I don’t even know where Caina lives…
She has to be somewhere… Maybe someone around here knows her…
Err… Do you have an appointment…?You need to sign in here…
Free food… I am pretty hungry…
Err… Welcome. Um… Do you have any Business here…?
Hey, I’ve been looking for you…
Hey, I’ve been looking for you…
Oh… Leahin… It’s you. What are you doing here…?
Hey, I’ve been looking for you…
Oh… Leahin… It’s you. What are you doing here…?
Oh, Err… I was visiting…And I need to ask, can I stay at your house for a while?
…What? Stay at my house? Like a sleepover? What are you talking about?
No… Just until tomorrow… I just need a place to stay…
Um… I’m just wondering… Why? You came all the way here for a place to stay? What’s wrong with your apartment?
Heh… to tell you the truth, I just need somewhere to hide. The corporation is after me.
The corporation?  I thought you settled it with them.
…I lied. They weren’t even after the money, just the work I could do for them.
You lied? What would you do that for?
Well, because I didn’t want you to worry. And I thought things wouldn’t turn out like this.
You didn’t want me to worry…? Why did that matter?
I… well… I don’t know. I just wasn’t thinking. Sorry…
It’s allright… I don’t really care.And you can stay, if you really want. You’re always welcome.
Well… are you gonna finish your meal?
…Hmm? Oh, sorry…It’s just I was thinking…
It’s the trip tomorrow…This is probably the last time I’ll ever be here…
Yeah… and probably never coming back. I’ll sure miss this place...
You’re leaving… well, It was bound to happen eventually.You travel a lot for your job, right?
Well, okay…We’ll keep in touch and still be friends, right?
Well, okay…We’ll keep in touch and still be friends, right?
Your arm… I never noticed it before… You always wore a glove over it…
Your arm… I never noticed it before… You always wore a glove over it…
And you’re wondering how I got it?
It’s from a long time ago… It… It doesn’t matter now.
You know what..? I’m not really hungry. I’m finished, lets go.
Come on… we’re leaving.Don’t worry about the trash… They’ll clean it up.
You don’t know where I live, right?Then follow me.
It’s in here.Come inside, You’re tired, right?
Well, I haven’t slept for days…I guess I am.
Admiring my beautiful form, are you?
So, this is your apartment…?Not really what I expected…
Not what you expected?Why? …Because It’s so messy?
Well… You can enjoy it to the fullest extent.  I’ve got to take a shower. If you really want, there’s some magazines lying around… read those.
Ha ha… wait around while you take a shower? I’m pretty good at that…
Nothing… Never mind… Forget I said it…
I’m gonna take a shower… don’t try anything messed up, okay?If you really want something to do, read some of the magazines lying around.
If you really want something to do, read some of the magazines lying around.And leave me alone, seriously.
Do you want me to friggin’ rip your head off?? LEAVE ME THE HECK ALONE!!
